news.title: Binance hack drained wallets backing customer assets, reserve data shows
news.summary: Binance’s own reserve data lists the drained wallets as backing customer balances, leaving its ether backing an estimated 6% short until the exchange replaces what was stolen.

news.title: Binance hack may involve private key ‘misuse,’ not theft: Blockaid CEO
news.summary: Blockaid’s Ido Ben-Natan suspects attackers manipulated Binance’s transaction-signing infrastructure, drawing parallels with the Bybit hack.

news.title: Binance hack rattles markets as BNB falls 8%, Bitcoin nears $77K
news.summary: Bitcoin, Ether and the broader crypto market took a dive as Binance suffered a multibillion-dollar hack.

news.title: Tampered Ledger reported in Singapore a month before news broke: Asia Express
news.summary: Singapore police say tampered Ledgers started showing up there on September 10. South Korean lawmakers look set to delay the crypto tax law for a fourth time.

news.title: Binance investigating hack as suspicious outflows reach up to $5.8 billion
news.summary: Tether and Circle froze $1.79 billion in USDT and USDC after billions moved out of Binance hot wallets. Binance says it is investigating.

news.title: Live updates: Binance says $3B in crypto frozen in connection to hack
news.summary: Follow live updates as Binance says $3 billion in assets has been frozen after a multibillion-dollar hack, with further freezes possible as investigators trace funds.

news.title: Binance loses $5.7 billion in 'biggest crypto hack in history'
news.summary: Crypto prices are sliding on the news, with bitcoin falling back to $77,000, though Binance's co-CEO said it would cover all losses.

news.title: Strategy reports $19.5 billion in Q3 net income as preferred shareholders approve daily dividends
news.summary: Strategy reported $19.53B in Q3 net income on a $20.91B bitcoin gain, holds 848,517 BTC, and moves preferreds to daily dividends.

news.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
news.summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

news.title: Public companies double share of blockchain revenue since 2022: Report
news.summary: A new 1kx report finds that public companies are capturing a larger share of blockchain revenue, driven by institutional adoption and real-world applications.

news.title: Polymarket suspended trading amid reports of user funds being drained
news.summary: The prediction markets platform halted trading on Thursday after it reported one of its third party providers had been compromised.

news.title: Polymarket resumes trading after $2.65 million exploit, says third-party provider was compromised
news.summary: After over $2.5 million was lost within minutes on Polymarket, the platform said it has since placed its exchange in cancel-only mode.

news.title: Polymarket suspends trading after third-party breach leads to user losses
news.summary: Polymarket said one of its third-party providers was breached after users reported seeing their accounts drained.

news.title: HYPE teases all-time high as NYSE owner ICE eyes US Hyperliquid perps
news.summary: Hyperliquid’s token pumped following news of ICE and Trade[XYZ] unveiling plans for US perpetual futures.

news.title: KuCoin suspends services in Russia and Belarus
news.summary: The exchange cited legal and regulatory compliance in its reason for cutting off services to users based in the two countries, currently the targets of international sanctions.

news.title: Stanley Druckenmiller's first X post backs Hyperliquid venture after $23 million indirect investment
news.summary: The billionaire investor disclosed an investment in Trade[XYZ] as the platform teams up with the NYSE's parent company. His family office previously reported owning shares in a HYPE-focused treasury company.

news.title: KuCoin exits Russia and Belarus as crypto exchanges withdraw from Western-sanctioned markets
news.summary: The exchange is closing accounts in both countries after MEXC and Bitget announced similar moves earlier this month.

news.title: From rivals to partners: Polygon and Solana team to bring stablecoin payments to banks
news.summary: The two networks are setting aside their rivalry to connect Solana's stablecoin activity with Polygon's banking, wallet and payment infrastructure.

news.title: Nasdaq-listed Canton Strategic Holdings plans tokenized stock trading from Nov. 2
news.summary: The tokenized shares would carry the same shareholder rights as traditional stock, with round-the-clock trading and immediate settlement under the SEC’s innovation exemption.

news.title: Crypto exchange HTX exits the UK after settling with the FCA
news.summary: The former Huobi exchange has stopped accepting deposits from British customers and agreed not to target them with crypto promotions.

news.title: Kalshi raises $1B at $40B valuation as non-sports revenue run rate tops $1B
news.summary: The funding round comes as Kalshi expands its partnerships with the NBA and S&P Dow Jones Indices while facing legal challenges over its sports contracts.

news.title: Bitcoin price jumps to $81.5K as US GDP data beats expectations
news.summary: BTC price action returned to a key weekly resistance level as US stock markets digested Alphabet’s Q3 earnings miss.

news.title: French Senate adopts bill for automatic sharing of crypto tax data
news.summary: The French Senate adopted a bill authorizing the automatic exchange of crypto-asset tax information between international tax authorities, pending completion of the legislative process.

news.title: Polymarket brings ultra-short crypto prediction markets to U.S. platform
news.summary: Polymarket’s new Up/Down crypto contracts come as the CFTC renews scrutiny of the prediction market’s compliance with its 2022 U.S. onboarding terms.

news.title: HYPE surges 15% as NYSE parent ICE moves to bring Hyperliquid perps to US
news.summary: NYSE parent ICE will partner with and invest in Trade[XYZ] to launch regulated, Hyperliquid-based perpetual futures in the U.S.

news.summary: Uniswap Labs has opened up its Token Jar fee conversion system to other apps through a new tool called TJAR.

news.title: Bank of England opens consultation on tokenized collateral for clearing
news.summary: Central counterparties would need to show tokenized collateral meets liquidity and risk tests under proposed Bank of England guidance.

news.title: Why Switzerland’s first genuine spot bitcoin ETF could soon attract overseas banks and brokers
news.summary: SIX Swiss Exchange confirms international access, while FINMA explains why it approved the fund and whether ether and solana ETFs could follow.

news.title: Chainlink adds weekend pricing for tokenized assets, with Aave as launch partner
news.summary: The service uses perpetual futures quotes to update reference prices when traditional markets close.

news.title: Canton Foundation grants RedStone 15.8M Canton Coin for pricing standard
news.summary: RedStone’s planned pricing tool will let institutions on Canton use shared market prices without exposing deal terms to data providers.

news.title: New quantum model slashes hardware needed to break bitcoin keys by 17 times
news.summary: Alice & Bob's new model reduces the hardware required for a potential attack, bringing it closer to reality and increasing pressure to adopt quantum-resistant security sooner.

news.title: Walmart, Eli Lilly join growing pushback against OKX–ICE tokenized stock plans
news.summary: Five more companies have objected, bringing the total to 38 as a rival Canton venue prepares to launch with an issuer-sponsored stock under the SEC's innovation exemption.

news.title: Brazil’s Halloween eve crypto deadline brings more tricks than treats
news.summary: Brazil’s crypto exchanges face an application deadline on Friday, with costly requirements and unanswered regulatory questions complicating compliance.

news.title: Private, fast USDT is coming to Bitcoin. Can it compete with Ethereum and Tron?
news.summary: USDT is coming home to Bitcoin, offering privacy and Lightning-fast payments. But can Bitcoin’s revamped version of Tether compete with stablecoins on ETH and TRON?

news.title: Polygon expands Open Money Stack to Solana, after Tron rollout
news.summary: The move follows the addition of Tron support and Polygon’s acquisition of Coinme.

news.title: Polygon adds Solana to payment stack linking bank accounts, crypto and payouts
news.summary: Polygon added Solana to its payments platform, connecting businesses to bank funding, cross-chain transfers, stablecoins and global payouts.

news.title: A new framework for tokenized asset tracking
news.summary: None of the numbers most commonly used to assess tokenized assets answer the question a chief investment officer would ask about those assets on her own balance sheet: what is it doing for me?

news.title: Tokenized stock venue on Canton could beat OKX–ICE to first trade under SEC framework
news.summary: The venue, called TSV LLC, plans to start trading shares Canton Strategic Holdings shares as early as Monday, using issuer-sponsored tokenization that avoids the 30-day company objection window.

news.title: Chainalysis traces North Korean crypto cash-outs through Garantex
news.summary: The analysis followed US sanctions against 10 people and one entity accused of helping North Korean IT worker schemes fund weapons programs.

news.title: Unlimit founder backs Phase blockchain with $45M as mainnet launches
news.summary: Phase’s new network lets smartphone owners earn tokens for validating transactions and sharing internet connections with AI agents.

news.title: HTX agrees to halt unlawful UK crypto promotions after FCA case
news.summary: HTX has pledged to stop crypto marketing in the UK until October 2031, with deposits and new account registrations already blocked there.

news.title: U.S. sanctions Russian nationals for laundering millions in crypto for North Korean IT workers
news.summary: Russian nationals Ilya Boykov and Vitold Obertas allegedly converted about $3.5 million and nearly $2 million in crypto, respectively, for North Korea.

news.title: As $10 billion in bitcoin options near expiry, the tell is in the pricing

news.title: EU investors rank crypto above retirement plans for lasting wealth creation: OKX survey
news.summary: European investors ranked crypto above retirement plans for lasting wealth creation, while prior surveys show US investors are skeptical on crypto’s role in retirement accounts.

news.title: Coinbase seeks Brazil crypto license, expects no service disruption
news.summary: Coinbase has applied for authorization ahead of Brazil’s Oct. 30 deadline and says it expects to maintain existing services while regulators review its application.

news.title: Bitcoin lending and yield could drive next wave of institutional demand, Rootstock says
news.summary: A new report argues that putting institutional Bitcoin holdings to work through lending, collateral and financing could create demand beyond its store-of-value role.

news.title: Bitcoin drops to $80,000 on Fed dissent, Samsung, Alphabet earnings; AI tokens slump
news.summary: Bitcoin fell 1.4% since midnight UTC to around $80,100 as disappointing reports from Samsung and Alphabet weighed on tech stocks. The Fed’s preferred inflation gauge is due later today.

news.title: NYSE owner takes steps to bring Hyperliquid perpetual futures to U.S.
news.summary: The planned ICE[XYZ] venue would offer 24/7 perpetual futures on stocks, commodities and crypto, pending CFTC approval. ICE is investing in Trade[XYZ].

news.title: Curve Finance launches on Stellar in first native deployment outside EVM ecosystem
news.summary: Curve Finance has launched on Stellar mainnet, its first native deployment outside the Ethereum Virtual Machine (EVM) ecosystem.

news.title: Cathie Wood’s ARK buys the dip on Robinhood in its largest purchase in 6 months after 23% slump
news.summary: HOOD fell 3.3% on Wednesday, broadening its one-month decline to more than 23%.

news.title: Bitcoin long-term resistance in focus as analysis sees selling risk above $85K
news.summary: BTC price analysis from Glassnode drew attention to $85,000 as the lower boundary of a cost-basis zone for long-term holders.

news.title: Solana wallet Solflare pledges to pay missed rewards on staked $160 million after validator goes offline
news.summary: About 1.56 million SOL sat on a validator that stopped earning, and the wallet still hasn’t named the firm that held its keys.

news.title: Live updates: Binance confirms security breach, says 'will cover all hacking losses'
news.summary: North of $5 billion appears to have been stolen from the world's biggest crypto exchange, Binance, of which some $2.5 billion has been frozen.

news.title: Thai Supreme Court rules bitcoin is property after thief challenges conviction
news.summary: The court said bitcoin has a market price, can be cashed out and held by the public. It upheld a 10-year sentence for a man who helped the robbers.

news.title: Bermuda taps WalletConnect to advance its onchain economy plan
news.summary: Bermuda chose WalletConnect to bring crypto payments to local merchants, starting with ticketing platform PTIX in the second quarter of 2027.

news.title: Former Swift CEO joins stablecoin firm OpenTrade as chairman
news.summary: Lazaro Campos takes the board role as the London-based company reports $300 million in assets locked and more than $1 billion in annual transaction volume.

news.title: Utah files criminal charges against Kalshi, executives over alleged illegal gambling
news.summary: Utah AG Derek Brown filed criminal charges against Kalshi, Tarek Mansour and Luana Lopes Lara for allegedly promoting online gambling.

news.title: Robinhood earnings miss, crypto weakness fail to shake Wall Street’s bullish outlook
news.summary: Bernstein sees Robinhood’s crypto business shifting toward infrastructure as new products like prediction markets and perps gain ground.

news.title: Bitwise raises bitcoin price target to $1.6 million by 2036, projects 34% annualized returns
news.summary: Bitwise's bear case puts bitcoin at $130,686 by 2036, while its bull case reaches $3.67 million over the next decade.

news.title: Coinbase adds Ripple’s RLUSD stablecoin across retail, exchange and Prime platforms
news.summary: RLUSD is live on Coinbase with 1:1 USD conversion on XRP Ledger, Ethereum and Base, capping a big week of news for Ripple.

news.title: Avail launches ShieldTX privacy tool targeting copy-trading bots on Hyperliquid
news.summary: Avail launched ShieldTX, a Hyperliquid privacy tool that creates a separate wallet for each perpetual futures position.

news.title: Crypto braces for potential shift in congressional oversight after midterms
news.summary: Post-Clarity Act, the crypto sector could find itself navigating a very different political landscape under a new Congress.

news.title: Ripple expects $900 million annualized product revenue run rate as institutional business expands
news.summary: Ripple expects a $900M annualized product revenue run rate by end of 2026, as RLUSD reaches $2.5B and payments near $150B in lifetime volume.

news.title: Moody’s assigns investment-grade ratings to Ripple’s RLUSD stablecoin
news.summary: Moody's Ratings assigned the RLUSD A2 long-term and P-1 short-term ratings, citing credit quality and market value of its reserve assets.

news.title: Datavault AI stock plummets 50% after firm says it cannot withdraw bitcoin tied to $150 million deal
news.summary: The issue centers on a deal with Scilex, under which Scilex agreed to buy shares of Datavault AI for $150 million, payable in bitcoin.

news.title: Robinhood Chain brings in $26 million as crypto revenue rises 20% in Q3
news.summary: Robinhood’s blockchain boosted crypto revenue, while prediction markets brought in $173 million in the third quarter.

news.title: CFTC sues Utah as battle over prediction market regulation intensifies
news.summary: The CFTC is escalating its legal fight with states, suing Utah after the state filed a lawsuit against prediction market platform Kalshi.

news.title: Crypto.com and OG.com launch US crypto perps with up to 5x leverage
news.summary: The contracts have no expiration date and allow traders to bet on crypto prices rising or falling.
